title: leucanthemum waldsteinii
intro: Leucanthemum waldsteinii, commonly known as Edelweiss, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family that is native to the mountainous regions of Central Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and stress. Leucanthemum waldsteinii contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
